weight_selection: validation only, common weights, equal hive contributions, LSTM >= 0.10
limitations: Retrospective transfer: pooled training includes later calendar years than some other-hive test origins. Not historical deployment performance.
Only 10 hives at two public sites; gap/event/context exclusions and all unsupported hives are retained explicitly.
Target intervals are chronologically disjoint across training/selection/calibration/test within each hive; development/test origins within a partition overlap.
All candidates use identical eligible origins. Operational scores retain future events; event-context origins are excluded and counted.
Training uses masked direct outputs for every genuinely available clean target, stopping at gap/event/partition cutoff; unavailable labels are never filled. Long-horizon training remains sparse.
Recorded source timezone unknown; no local-day/night interpretation. Only already observed ambient temperature is an input.
Chronos pretraining overlap with these public datasets is unknown; unseen-pretraining generalization is not established.
Common ensemble weights selected on development endpoints at 1/24/72/168h with equal hive contributions; not tuned on calibration/test.
No honey maturity, reserves, harvest yield or harvest-outcome labels exist. Forecast performance does not validate harvest outcomes.
This extends an already inspected test: regression comparison, not a newly sealed test.
Frozen existing LSTM/Chronos predictions are reused; their training and selection are unchanged.
TiRex-2 pretraining overlap with the public bee datasets is unknown.
Inference includes cold loading in a separate CPU worker; no runtime MPS performance claim.
No production model alias is changed by this script.
